description: A marked-out construction site. Bring the materials it still needs.

script.lore: A building is going up here. Each delivered material brings it closer; when nothing more is needed it is finished.

alerts.message: The construction site still needs logs from the forest.
The construction site still needs stone from the quarry.
The construction site still needs planks (saw logs at the workbench).
The construction site needs bread for the builders' feast (bake wheat in the oven).
